first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The Blue Sky area above the horizon, with a lighter color near the horizon.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The light yellowish-brown grass covering the open ground surface and the brown bare soil between it.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: The Scattered Trees and Shrubs distributed across the grassland, with canopies mainly appearing as dark greenish-brown conical or irregular clumps.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: The narrow sections of brown bare soil and linear ground marks amid the grassland in the lower-right part of the frame, limited to the area visible in this clip.

entities.name: Distant Cluster of Low-Rise Buildings
entities.identification: The cluster of light gray and off-white block-shaped buildings distributed horizontally near the horizon, with a few rectangular structures rising above the surrounding roofline.
